extracted.name: Cap Cai
extracted.description: Learn how to make cap cai. Shrimp, broccoli, cauliflower, and other vegetables are simmered with oyster sauce in this tasty Indonesian dish.
ingredient_lines: 10 ounces peeled and deveined medium shrimp (30-40 per pound)
1 large carrot, thinly sliced at an angle
instruction_lines: Heat vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Stir in garlic and onion; cook and stir until onion has softened and turned translucent, about 5 minutes. Add shrimp, bok choy, broccoli, cauliflower, carrot, and green onion. Pour in water, cover, and cook until shrimp is no longer translucent in the center and vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.
Dissolve cornstarch into fish sauce in a small bowl. Stir into the cap cai along with oyster sauce, sugar, and pepper; stir until thickened. Season with salt before serving.
